data.one_liner: Blurry image placeholder generator and decoder using native FFI bindings.
data.what_it_does: Generates and decodes Blurhash image placeholders for Flutter using native C FFI bindings. It supports encoding any ImageProvider and decoding blurhashes via widgets, image providers, or static methods running in a separate isolate.
use_when: You need high-performance Blurhash encoding and decoding in Flutter
You want to display blurry placeholders while loading images across mobile and desktop platforms
avoid_when: You prefer a pure Dart implementation without native FFI dependencies
strengths: Matches official Blurhash performance and quality via native C implementation
Supports encoding and decoding across Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, and Windows
Runs heavy tasks in a separate isolate to avoid UI jank
weaknesses: Requires manual release of isolate and memory using BlurhashFFI.free() when done
